author: Nintendo_Unity
body:
IGN: My username is Nintendo_Unity.
Discord(Name#): My Discord is Nintendo_Unity#4698.
Timezone: My timezone is GMT-6. 
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I really like to ref matches on tournaments, I like to communicate with the teams, hearing them strating and talking, and the most things, it's to have a better a communication between the teams and provide some fun and entertainment. 
Best time of the week?: I can read or be aware of notifications / notices actively by Discord. On weekends, I can be active on mornings of both days (Saturday and Sunday) unless real weird exceptions (like weddings or classes, but it's weird to happen). I can't on Saturday afternoons and probably at Sunday afternoon. 
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself (Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): I am a very friendly person and I'm honestly really happy to work with others and helping in things. If tournies and tournament matches makes the teams happy, I will be really happy to provide or help for making it possible, so it can be that happiness for the teams and community. I like to meet new people and talking to them, new communities to see.
Anything else?: My native language is Spanish (I am from México) but I don't have any problems with english and communications. 
My past experience:
I'm an active referee for the Stratus Network and Pagoda Network.
I have reffed 6 tournaments, 5 of them unofficials and 1 official. (5 of them was Referee, and 1 of them was Official).
Thanks for reading!:)
